content.rendered:
Kindergarten Registration Now Open

Registration for our fall kindergarten students is now open! We have created a special edition newsletter for our Fall 2024 Kindergarten families! The newsletter can be found linked here and includes information about registration, Kindergarten Open House, and other upcoming kindergarten events. If you know of a family that will have a kindergartener at Ridges in the fall (age 5 by or on September 1st), but is not yet a part of our school to receive this information, please share the newsletter link with them!
